question: Which one of the following passes is located at the crest of the Western Ghats and connects Mumbai with Pune?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhor Ghat Pass.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• Bhor Ghat Pass is between Kasara and Khandala on the Mumbai Pune Express Highway.
